title: Soul Eater Spear
paragraphs: “Bububu, Bubububu!”
“‘I am overflowing with power, even more than when I was alive. I am the one most suited to rule the world!’? Give me a break! Is causing misery the only thing you’re capable of?!”
Father snapped. He was glaring with an intensity like never before. Even he had reached his limit.
“Bububu, Bubu, Bububububu!”
“You even devoured the leader of the demons… Are you really human?! Queen, just what is Princess Malty?!” Éclair asked the Queen.
This thing is way too persistent.
Could it be… that it was in the underground waterway even in the previous cycle? Hmm, I fully intend to kill it, but I need to figure out how.
“I don’t know. However, there were many suspicious things about her since childhood. Could this be her true nature…?”

“No, that’s not it. Even as a ghost, she must have wormed her way into Trash and manipulated the staff to gain power. Then, by aligning herself with various forces, she likely strengthened her hold through revolution.”
Well, it is the Crimson Swine, after all. Even when it tried to pick a fight with Father’s territory, it had been scheming and working behind the scenes to instigate a revolution.
“Bubububu!”
“You intend to consume every soul in this world?! Everyone, this entity is more dangerous than the Waves! We must take it down immediately!”
“I know that, but… even with anti-undead weapons, we can’t leave a single scratch!”
“Y-Yeah, but still!”
Itsuki, Ren, and I were all using weapons meant for undead, attacking the ghost of the Crimson Swine. By the logic of games and the common sense of this world, they should be effective.
“Everyone!”
At that moment, Father called out.
“What is it?”
“It’s clearer from a distance, but that princess’ ghost… she’s replenishing her soul energy on the spot!”
“Not this pattern again! Give me a break already!”
Itsuki and Ren retreated toward Father while maintaining their defenses.
“Motoyasu! You too!”
“Bubu, Bubububububu!”
The Crimson Swine reached for me with an unnervingly eerie hand, grabbing my collar. It was freezing cold.
“An attack of this level won’t extinguish the burning passion inside me!”
The Crimson Swine was skilled in fire magic. And so was I…

But fire can either merge or cancel each other out. The thought that we might have once been working together in some way sent a chill down my spine. I focused my energy into my spear and used Brionac to knock the Crimson Swine’s hand away.
“It’s even consuming the souls of the living… devouring the souls of the expanding territory at high speed… How are we supposed to defeat a monster like this?”
“This is already her domain. She’s being granted infinite power—how can we possibly defeat her?!”
“There has to be a way. Even though she’s replenishing herself, there must be a decisive attack that can put an end to that princess…”
Father and Itsuki seem to be using all their game knowledge. For now, light-based magic seems to be effective, making it difficult for the Crimson Swine to attack us.
“Isn’t this exactly the kind of situation where ritual magic like ‘sanctuary’ should be used?”
“It has already been deployed.”
The Queen held up her staff, continuing her chant along with Fiancé and Éclair. That’s why the burden is being reduced.
“We’re doing it too!”
Yuki-chan and the other Filolials also seem to be chanting Sanctuary.
“Gaelion won’t lose either!”
Even Rival, along with Assistant and Mole, is casting a similar spell.
“Either way, it’s only for defense.”
“Naofumi’s Moon Shield seems to be enhancing everyone’s magic effects, but we still lack offensive power.”
“Anything effective against demonic ghosts just disperses them for a moment before they regenerate. Stronger skills seem to phase right through due to attribute differences.”
“Bububu, Bububu… Bubu!”
“We’re holding out somehow, but… aren’t skeletons and zombies starting to swarm toward us? Outside the castle!”

When Father pointed, I looked in that direction. Sure enough, undead creatures were rushing toward the castle at an incredible speed. Wow, even the corpses of various monsters are mixed in. Is this the underworld or something?
“That ghost keeps summoning more spirits, devouring them, and growing exponentially stronger…”
“We need to finish this quickly, but we have no means to do so. Even if we consider retreating, it seems portals aren’t working.”
“Are we trapped?”
“That’s it! What if we summon the Four Guardian Beasts that Motoyasu mentioned? Since they deal with souls, they might consume it!”
Father shifted his gaze toward Rival. Ah, he’s right in front of us.
“You want to break the seal on the Dragon Emperor?”
“If you do that, Gaelion-chan will…”
Indeed. If Rival becomes the Dragon Emperor and devours the Crimson Swine’s soul, we can finish it off. That would resolve everything.
“Gaelion is fine! If I can protect Naofumi and the others, I’m not afraid!”
“No!”
Assistant clung to him, shaking her head.
“This might be fate. If it’s for the world as the Dragon Emperor, I don’t mind!”
“Bubububu!”

As if to prevent that from happening, the Crimson Swine started attacking us. Now that it has realized we have a potential way to defeat it, it’s desperately trying to kill Rival with magic, psychological attacks, undead summoning, demon summoning, wall-passing attacks, soul extraction, and all sorts of assaults. However, thanks to the triple-layered defense, including Father’s, we are barely holding on. Rival is spreading her wings, showing signs of separating from her parent.
“Bubu, Bububu!”
“Ahh, enough! You’re too noisy! Just shut up already!”

Honestly, I was already irritated that I couldn’t take it down in a single blow. At this point, maybe I should just use the Crimson Swine as a punching bag to my heart’s content before Rival manages to do anything!
“Brionac X! Aiming Lancer X! Meteor Spear X! Grand Windmill X! Liberation Prominence X!”
Oh! Every time I strike, the Crimson Swine recoils, and I’m starting to feel a bit better.
“Motoyasu-kun! Don’t waste your strength unnecessarily!”
“Hahaha! It’s not like the number of casualties is going to decrease anyway! So I might as well experiment a little!”

Oh? The moment I step outside Father’s barrier, my SP starts dropping at an alarming rate. It’s because of the soul, isn’t it? The Crimson Swine’s regeneration speed is increasing in response. The field itself seems to have a drain effect.
Then I’ll use this! I transformed my spear into the Soul Eater Spear. It seems that Father has some kind of drain immunity.
I have it too! And this Soul Eater Spear has a special effect called Soul Devour. With this, I can steal back the SP I’ve lost and unleash an endless barrage of skills!
“Lunatic Judgment X!”
“Bubuhiii—!?”
Oh? This time, when I struck the Crimson Swine’s chest, it recoiled even harder than before. And it’s not regenerating!
“Motoyasu-san! What is that weapon!?”
“It’s a weapon that came from a monster called a Soul Eater that appeared during the Waves!”
“A devourer of souls… I see! It’s even more effective than weapons specialized against demons!”
“Oh! Now that you mention it, it has a special effect called Soul Eater, which is effective against spirits!”
That said, I have no desire to devour the Crimson Swine’s soul.
“Either way! If we can save Gaelion-chan without sacrificing him, then Motoyasu-kun, do whatever it takes!”
“Understood! Aiming Lancer X! Brionac X! Meteor Spear X! Thunder Spear X!”
I launched a relentless series of attacks on the ghost of the Crimson Swine without even giving it a chance to breathe.
“B—Buhii! Buhi… Buhibuhibuhibubu…”
As I pummeled it, the Crimson Swine started squealing and pretending to be weak.
“I have no idea what you’re saying.”
I mercilessly drove my spear straight into its forehead.
“Uh… it was saying something like ‘I’ve regained my sanity, please don’t attack me anymore’ while crying…”
“That’s a lie. Malty always lies when she says things like that.”
“There’s no way Sister would ever feel remorse. If she’s begging for mercy, it’s because she’s trying to deceive us.”
“Exactly. Someone who could fake-cry so shamelessly isn’t going to suddenly regain her sanity and expect us to believe it.”
Looks like the Queen and the others know the Crimson Swine’s personality very well.
“Bububu, Bubububu.”
“Even as a ghost, you want to support us? Sorry, but we don’t trust you. After all, you were the mastermind behind all the chaos in this country.”
“Hey, hey, hey. Why are her eyes darting around?”
“That’s the kind of crying that has acting mixed in.”
“Hey, hey, hey. Why is she lying?”
The Filolial-sama’s curiosity has been piqued. Which means, without a doubt, she’s lying about something. Just like with Itsuki.
“So Gaelion doesn’t have to become the Dragon Emperor?”
“Looks like it.”
“Thank goodness…”
“Yeah, really.”
“I’m so relieved…”
Rival, Assistant, and Mole are all sharing in the joy. Rival is licking Assistant and Mole, as if to comfort them.
“Even the Aultcray who adored you unconditionally abandoned you. There is no salvation for you anymore, Malty… or rather, the massive ghost that threatens this nation.”
“Buhi! Bububuhiiiiiiiiiiiiii!”

“Whoa. She showed her true colors. ‘Guh… I’ll make sure to destroy you all, body and soul! I don’t care what happens after! I’ll wipe out even the memory of this country’s existence with a soul explosion!’ That’s what she’s saying, Motoyasu-kun!”
“Then I’ll just kill her soul too! Burst Lance X!”
“Buhiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiii—…!”
For the second time in this loop, I’ve annihilated the Crimson Swine. I fired a Burst Lance from the Soul Eater Spear and obliterated the Crimson Swine’s soul!
